label: Every PURE_ACT_5 being that HAS_INTELLECT_1 operates from itself
paraphrase: Open premise, analyst formulation, unattributed; the intellect-restricted version of STMT-PURE-ACT-OPERATES. Whatever is in potency in no respect (PURE_ACT) and has intellect (HAS_INTELLECT_1) has an immanent operation (Operates, 7acc985a). Weaker than STMT-PURE-ACT-OPERATES (Control part 6: a pure act without intellect that does not operate) and stronger than 'Whatever has the nine operates from itself' (Control part 7: an intellectual pure act that lacks the nine and does not operate). Derived from the three capacity premises; it does not mention life.
